tasks.label: LaTeX: Compile main.pdf (latexmk)
tasks.detail: Full build with latexmk (resolves all refs, citations, TOC)

tasks.label: LaTeX: Compile single chapter (fast)
tasks.detail: Quick compile of one chapter. Prompts for chapter name (e.g., chapters/ch01-markets-bonds)

tasks.label: LaTeX: Clean build artifacts
tasks.detail: Removes all generated files (aux, log, pdf, etc.)

tasks.label: LaTeX: Clean everything (including build folder)
tasks.detail: Nuclear clean - removes build folder and all stray aux files

tasks.label: LaTeX: Check spelling (chktex)
tasks.detail: Runs chktex linter on main.tex (catches style issues, not just errors)

tasks.label: LaTeX: Word count (texcount)
tasks.detail: Counts words in the whole document (includes \input/\include files)

tasks.label: LaTeX: Open PDF in default viewer
tasks.detail: Opens the compiled PDF in your default PDF viewer
